title: Finite exact presentation data after generic localization
statement: Let R be a commutative integral domain, B a commutative finite type R-algebra, and M a finite B-module. There exist a nonzero a in R and natural numbers n,m with a surjective localized-linear map f : (Fin n → B_a) → M_a and a localized-linear map g : (Fin m → B_a) → (Fin n → B_a) such that g,f are exact.

source.place: Tag 051T, algebra-lemma-generic-flatness, proof: polynomial presentation and generic freeness

proof.text: Choose a polynomial algebra surjecting onto B and a finite set of module generators. Over the fraction field of R, Noetherianity gives finitely many relation generators; clear denominators and apply generic freeness to the resulting finitely presented quotient. After localizing at a suitable nonzero a, the relation columns give the displayed exact sequence.
